services.name: Past Exhibitions
services.desc: Through painting, sculpture, and photography, notable Canadian artists explore winter as both a physical environment and a metaphor for the emotional and psychological experience of enduring difficult times. Follow the story of Painters Eleven, a group of trailblazing abstract artists whose ethos was defined by creative freedom, diversity of approach, and a refusal to accept aethestic complacency. Join a community of art lovers and help the Audain Art Museum thrive. Your contribution supports exhibitions, education and the preservation of British Columbia’s artistic legacy. Experience the Museum year-round and help sustain the arts in British Columbia. Members enjoy unlimited gallery

services.name: Docent Tour
services.desc: The Audain Art Museum team is excited to have launched guided school programs that complement BC curriculums and enrich the education of children and youth. The Museum has dedicated Wednesdays to hosting student groups. To be added to the distribution list for school program information, please contact connect@audainartmuseum.com. Thank you for your interest. By studying stories and transformation through a piece of art, or a body of work, students can appreciate the rich cultural history, the evolution of style and identity, and/or the mythological or evocative commentary of the artist. services.name: Event Rentals
services.desc: Host your next unforgettable event at the Audain Art Museum-Whistler’s premier arts venue nestled in the heart of the mountains. Whether you’re planning a wedding, corporate gathering, or private reception, the Museum offers a selection of stunning spaces that seamlessly blend contemporary architecture with the natural beauty of British Columbia. Surrounded by iconic works of art and world-class design, your event will be elevated by an atmosphere of creativity and sophistication. With a variety of rental packages and a dedicated team to support your vision, the Audain Art Museum provides a truly unique setting for any occasion.
